d: MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Logistics Analyst I to join our vehicle sustainment team in Kuwait. The selected candidate will provide maintenance and logistics support to multiple families of vehicles globally on the Allied Logistics Engineering Capabilities Sustainment (ALECS) program.
q: 3 + years of experience in logistics or a related field; 1 year of college in related field accepted in lieu of 1.5 years of experience.
Must possess at least two years of documented Global Combat Support System –Army (GCSS-A) experience.
Experience in military STAMIS, or applicable commercial Logistics Management Information System (LMIS).
Experience in creating work orders, material requisitioning, shop supply listings, Plant 2000 operations and creating unit ESR report and employee management.

Experience in the receipt, accountability, inventory, and requisition of equipment, spare parts, and supplies, including maintaining stock levels; experience in operating material and handling equipment.
Ability to successfully pass a Pre-Employment Drug Screening; ability to meet the government deployment physical requirements.

Candidates must hold a current and active passport, ensuring a minimum of two years of validity from their start date; Must have a High School Diploma or GED and must possess a Valid Driver’s License.
Familiarity with military or commercial logistics supply system as well as automated and manual supply systems and equipment serviceability standards and criteria.
Willingness to travel to hostile areas is desired.
Willingness to travel to various US or OCONUS locations.
Must be a US Citizen and have a current/active Secret clearance.
Must be able to balance, bend, carry, crouch, stretch and kneel.
Must be able to push, pull, and reach.
Must be able to work with computers and CRTs, and type on a computer keyboard.

d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic Maintenance professionals who take pride in their ability to deliver exceptional levels of customer service and provide effective solutions to meet our guests’ needs.

As a Plumber, you will be responsible for installing, repairing and maintaining plumbing systems, fixtures and equipment used for water distribution and wastewater disposal, ensuring all work complies with relevant standards, regulations and safety requirements.
q: You should ideally have completed a plumbing apprenticeship and have previous experience in a similar position.

You must be familiar with working in accordance with established policies, procedures and safety regulations, and be in good physical condition. A good command of English, together with strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to identify faults and carry out effective repairs, is essential.
The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, practical and hands-on, with a flexible approach to work and the ability to adapt to changing priorities and unexpected situations.

You should be proactive, reliable and capable of working efficiently in a busy environment while remaining calm under pressure. Strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team are essential.
The successful candidate should possess the following competencies
